meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容做成分页演示文稿,支持分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,能直接翻页讲解。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把想法变成一份可现场翻页讲解、带备注的演示文稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into a deck you can present page by page with notes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 编写幻灯片演示:离散幻灯片、分段显示、分支与热点跳转,并带演讲者备注的演示模式;也能把现有网页转成这种演示。产出是可导航的演示文稿,不是导出的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片时接管;若只是提到「presentation」「pitch deck」「把页面转成演示」等相邻说法,它会先暂停并确认要不要做成幻灯片再动手。

say.text: 把这份 BRIEF 做成一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片演示
say.note: 它按幻灯片写作规则编写离散幻灯片

say.text: 把这个页面转换成幻灯片,保留原有视觉和交互
say.note: 走源页面移植流程,不做简化替代

say.text: 给这张幻灯片加热点,点击跳到市场深挖那一支

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode; it also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. For adjacent asks like "presentation", "pitch deck" or "convert this page", it pauses and confirms before authoring.

say_en.text: Build this BRIEF into a HyperFrames slideshow
say_en.note: Authors discrete slides per the writing rules

Add a hotspot on this slide that jumps to the market deep-dive branch
